content.text:
issuer: http://dex:5556/dex

storage:
  type: sqlite3
  config:
    file: /var/dex/dex.db

web:
  http: 0.0.0.0:5556

oauth2:
  responseTypes: [code]
  skipApprovalScreen: true
  grantTypes:
    - authorization_code
    - refresh_token

expiry:
  idTokens: 24h        # JWT ID token valid 24h (dev convenience — was 1h default)
  signingKeys: 6h

enablePasswordDB: true

# oidc-bootstrap-only-config (ADR-022): a SINGLE OIDC client serves Matrix Bearer
# validation AND admin operator login. It registers ALL Nebu redirect URIs (Matrix
# SSO redirect, Element auth.html, and /admin/callback). The former separate
# `nebu-admin` client is removed — there is no second client.
staticClients:
  - id: nebu-gateway
    name: "Nebu"
    secret: nebu-dev-secret
    redirectURIs:
      - "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login/sso/redirect/oidc"
      - "http://localhost:7070/auth.html"
      - "http://localhost:8008/admin/callback"
